# Sample journal entries for llmcompare: one per line, '#' lines are ignored.
# English entries first, then Swahili/Sheng, so provider language mirroring can
# be compared directly.

I finally told my sister how overwhelmed I have felt lately, and she just listened.
Work has been heavy, but I took a short walk at lunch and it helped a little.
I miss my grandmother today. The rain reminded me of her kitchen.
I woke up anxious again, but I still made it to the gym.
Today I said no to something I did not have the energy for, and I feel lighter.
My friend canceled on me and I felt more hurt than I expected.
I am proud that I finished the report, even though it took all night.
I keep comparing myself to everyone else and it drains me.
Small win: I drank water and slept before midnight.
I feel stuck, like nothing I do changes anything.

# Swahili / Sheng
Leo nimechoka sana lakini nimefurahi kwa sababu nimekamilisha kazi yangu.
Nimekosa mama yangu leo. Nataka tu kuzungumza naye.
Nilipatwa na wasiwasi asubuhi lakini nikaenda kazini.
Rafiki yangu alinikataa leo na nimeumia roho.
Nashukuru kwa afya yangu, hata kama maisha ni magumu.
Nimemaliza mazoezi ya kupumua na nimepata utulivu.
Siku hii ilikuwa ndefu, lakini nimejifunza kusema hapana.
Nampenda mpenzi wangu lakini tuna shida ya kuwasiliana.
Nimekaa na familia yangu jioni na nilijisikia salama.
Kesho nitajaribu tena, hata kama leo ni ngumu.
